name: Puppy Girl Dog Fighting
source:
Dot has tried her best to be a good dog — but when you're a dumb mutt, sometimes your best isn't enough. Abandoned by her owners, she has no choice but to train under a champion fighter for her chance in the ring.  When Dot tries to get closer to her, things start to go wrong...

OR: If Uma Musume was about a puppy girl sold on Craigslist.

[From [url=https://glitch-heart.itch.io/pgdf]itch.io[/url]]
